pages.text: The world is old, and magical, and has always been both. There are dragons in the high places and things in the caves with too many faces. Ordinary people farm turnips forty miles from something that could eat the village, and consider this normal, because it is.
pages.title: Veldora

pages.text:
They dug down in order to reach up - deeper every generation, building something enormous and downward whose only purpose was to throw them upward.

Every layer of the Deep Works is a course in a foundation. The bottom of the world is the base of a ladder.

And they reached. And when reaching, it shattered.
pages.title: The Ladder
